concept: Understanding a situation from another person's position before responding to it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student navigates a conflict or negotiation scenario (e.g. group project disagreement) where understanding the other side's position changes the best move
exercise.branching_choice: Student's response changes depending on whether they consider the other person's likely motivation first
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how understanding the other side's position changed the outcome

assessment.success_marker: student can describe the situation from the other party's likely perspective, not just their own
